subject.title: fix(gateway): don't retire parent Codex binding when creating a detached dashboard child

question: Should `sessions.create` permanently expose `succeedsParent` as the generic contract for deciding whether child creation rolls over its parent, despite current main already protecting the Codex detached-child case?
rationale: The branch is mechanically coherent and preserves the omitted legacy behavior, but source inspection cannot choose whether this additional public gateway API is the intended durable lifecycle model or unnecessary expansion beyond the merged Codex fix.

options.title: Adopt explicit disposition
options.body: Approve `succeedsParent` as the public lifecycle contract and retain the branch's compatibility and boundary tests.

options.title: Keep the scoped Codex fix
options.body: Rely on the merged cross-key Codex guard and avoid adding a new gateway protocol parameter unless another concrete hook consumer requires it.

options.title: Specify a different lifecycle model
options.body: Define a different owner-approved representation or caller default, then revise this branch to that contract.

recommendation.title: Keep the scoped Codex fix
recommendation.body: Rely on the merged cross-key Codex guard and avoid adding a new gateway protocol parameter unless another concrete hook consumer requires it.
